0.0: Did my master make it past those scary monsters? *bark* It's been a long time since he left to go study. He should've come back by now...
0.1: *bark* I'd love to go see him myself, but I don't think I can handle the monsters yet, so... *bark* You! You can handle the monsters! Can you find my master for me? *bark* *bark* Just to see if he's okay. *bark*

yes.0: *bark* Good human! *bark* You smell like garbage!
yes.1: My master is doing his studies at a safe place in Orbis Tower, bark. His name is HUCKLE! *bark* *bark*

no.0: My master should be somewhere around Orbis Tower. *bark* *bark* Please find him...

1.0: Are you interested in my work? Well, I'm afraid I can't discuss it yet. What? No? Then what are you here for?
1.1: My Moppie? The cute little Moppie that followed my every move? Oh, I remember him! He was tiny, but he was a very loyal dog ...
1.2: Wait, Moppie's all grown up now? Has the time gone by that fast? I remember he used to fit in my bag when I got here... and now he's waiting for me...

yes.0: Thanks for finding me here. You even took care of my Moppie. I must say, you're a person of great heart. Thank you.

npc.0: You haven't found my master? *bark* He's at Orbis Tower! His name is HUCKLE! *bark* *bark*

QuestInfo.name: A Request from Moppie
QuestInfo.0: You should check up on Moppie, who's been waiting a long time for his ever-busy master.
QuestInfo.1: You should find Moppie's master, Huckle, since he was the one that who Moppie with the words 'I'll be back' as he went on his with studies. Huckle should be somewhere safe in Orbis Tower, still working on his studies... but where, exactly?
QuestInfo.2: You found Huckle, who was diligently working on his studies at the Orbis Tower. He looked like he hadn't bathed in weeks.
